text:
incident-bot: PAGER: org=cascade elevated QPS on /v1/generate — increased 5x baseline, elevated 502/503 and 429s observed. Paging @maria (oncall). Alert: https://redwood.ops/alerts/ALRT-6112

maria: Oncall here, looking. Seeing ~5x baseline QPS to /v1/generate, error rate ~12% 502/503 and ~8% 429s at edge. Impacting realtime customers. Going to request a temporary org-specific rate bump and disable expensive rerank route. Standby.

jon: copy. What's current org quota and per-route limit? Do we have runbook link? @lena can you pull traces and topo?

lena: current org quota = 200 rps, per-route gen-limit = 40 rps. Runbook: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/traffic-mitigation. Traces show heavy retries from 3 client IPs in org, long tail in KV cache misses.

maria: Proposed emergency actions: 1) bump org quota -> 400 rps for 15m 2) set per-route gen limit -> 160 rps 3) enable adaptive-smoothing (burst window 30s) 4) disable rerank for this org (feature flag). Plan: apply bump now, monitor 10m, then step down to 250 rps for cooldown.

kai: I can apply the override now. Command:```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/orgs/cascade/rate_override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"quota_rps":400,"per_route":{"gen":160},"expires_in":"15m","reason":"emergency spike - incident 6112233445"}'
```

jon: I'll watch infra metrics and tail logs. Oncall handoff plan: maria -> jon for 60m after stabilization.

maria: applying now.

incident-bot: deploybot: rate override applied by kai at 6112233452

lena: metrics: error rate dropped to ~2.1% within 3m, 429s down from 8% -> 0.5%, tail latency improving.

paul: Support update: customer's primary contact reports intermittent failures but seeing improvement. I messaged: "we applied a temporary capacity increase and are monitoring".

maria: disabling rerank flag now.

incident-bot: featureflag service: cascade.rerank disabled at 6112233461

jon: good. Keeping override for 15m then step down to 250 rps for cooldown. Creating follow-up ticket TCK-7832 to evaluate sustained capacity request and client retry patterns.

maria: handing oncall -> jon for next 60m. If anything regresses, page PD immediately. :rotating_light:

jon: Taking over. I'll monitor dashboards and logs; will perform rollback plan after stabilization. :thumbsup:

lena: FYI traces show many of the errors came from aggressive client retries without backoff. Recommend we ask the client's engineering contact to implement exponential backoff; adding note to TCK-7832.

incident-bot: NOTE: last_message_ts 6112233478 — thread will remain in incidents until rollback confirmed.
